title: Extension Entry
description: The envelope for data defined by a declared extension, attached at a hook that a host schema declares (core/extension-hook.json). `uri` + `digest` identify one immutable extension definition (same reference format and fetch contract as platform-extension-ref.json). `data` is validated against that definition's schema for this hook; core never interprets it. A receiver that does not hold a module for `uri@digest` MUST reject the enclosing object when the entry is must-understand (the hook's must_understand policy, or the flag when the policy is `flag`), and MUST ignore the entry otherwise. Within one message, entries with the same `uri` MUST carry the same `digest`; divergent digests fail closed. `digest` is the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization of the definition; producers serve the definition as its JCS bytes, so it also equals the SHA-256 of the response body.

must_understand.description: True when a receiver that does not understand this extension MUST NOT act on the enclosing object (the JWS `crit` rule, RFC 7515 §4.1.11). Read only at hooks whose policy is `flag`.

data.description: Extension data. Its schema is the extension definition's schema for this hook.
